title: Molecular identity and complete bonded carrier
statement: A molecule is one finite neutral multi-atomic carrier whose complete bonded graph is connected and whose constituent occurrence and element identities remain retained.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered molecule cardinality, bonding, connectivity, charge, composition, identity, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite generated multi-atomic carrier with complete connected bond support, retained constituent identity and no open net-charge fibre at the registered observation boundary.

choices.name: single-atomic-occurrence
choices.reason: One occurrence has no internal molecular bond graph.

choices.name: multiple-atomic-occurrences
choices.reason: A molecular carrier contains more than one atomic occurrence.

choices.name: unbonded-collection
choices.reason: A collection without joining support is not one molecule.

choices.name: complete-bond-support
choices.reason: Every registered joining channel is retained.

choices.name: one-connected-component
choices.reason: Every atomic occurrence is joined within one finite component.

choices.name: open-net-charge-fibre
choices.reason: An open net fibre describes a molecular ion rather than the neutral molecular class.

choices.name: closed-charge-boundary
choices.reason: Opposed internal fibres close with no open net charge.

choices.name: anonymous-atom-count
choices.reason: Counts without element identities cannot reproduce the carrier.

choices.name: constituent-identities-retained
choices.reason: Every occurrence and element label remains held.

choices.name: formula-alone
choices.reason: Equal composition need not imply one molecular structure.

choices.name: complete-structure-identity
choices.reason: Composition and bonded organization jointly identify the carrier.

choices.name: molecule-label-only
choices.reason: A label cannot reconstruct atoms and bonds.

choices.name: complete-carrier-trace
choices.reason: Occurrences, labels, edges and closure remain auditable.

choices.name: free-molecule-exception
choices.reason: An exception can admit arbitrary aggregates.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: The complete connected neutral carrier supplies the class.

induction_base: Two atomic occurrences joined by one retained bond with no open net-charge fibre supply the first molecule.
induction_step: Appending one generated bonded occurrence preserves connectivity, closed charge and all prior occurrence, element and edge identities.
exclusions: no chemical dictionary, coordinate archive, fitted force field, measured geometry or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application or opaque prediction result
no claim that topology alone predicts every measured coordinate or energy
external content remains inaccessible until after the consequence is sealed
Every finite generated multi-atomic carrier with complete connected bond support, retained constituent identity and no open net-charge fibre at the registered observation boundary.
operational_witnesses: two same-element occurrences remain a valid connected molecular carrier
falsification_condition: The claim fails if the official molecular record lacks multiple atomic constituents, one bonded chemical entity or retained constituent identity, or if a changed row is accepted.
